title: Story of this site
intro: We in tech love to invent concepts, terms and words that may sound incredibly complex to many. It reminds me of times explaining to friends and colleagues what is Cloud, Data Lake or Lakehouse, Delta and many others. This time with AI, we have more! :) — Skill, Harness, Temperature, Reasoning, Inference, Evals, Semantics, Vectors, Context Window, Retrieval Augmented Generation.

I've always believed that if I can't explain something simply, I don't understand it well enough. This motivates me to learn more and dig into its deeper meaning and impact. And with AI assistance, I have been spending a few hours each week putting these concepts into words and made them accessible to all.
This is Everyday AI for Humans — plain-language and technical reads of the AI ideas that keep coming up.

While most AI writing picks a specific audience, here every concept ships twice — an Everyday read that leans on analogy, and a Technical read that keeps the mechanism — each walked through the audiences it actually matters to, though the Technical read skips the plain everyday-user angle a practitioner doesn't need.
